properties.name: Delta zone
properties.note: Where the c.1998 baylands layer (SFEI EcoAtlas poster) does not reach: the part of SFEI's Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta historical-ecology study area (convex hull of its polygons) inside the map extent and east of 121.86 W. Inside it terrain_tiles.py takes diked land from the dl_* rows of fill_zones.csv and leaves other c.1800 tidal marsh as marsh.
